run_inference_torch_data: run the UmeTrack inference script to evaluate hand pose keypoint errors on real and synthetic test datasets
unpack_batched_data: unpack batched ModelInput data into per-frame InputFrameData, InputFrameDesc, and InputSkeletonData tuples for multiv or singlev sequence modes
eval_batch: evaluate a batch of model inputs against ground truth targets and return per-sample keypoint errors in millimeters
load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained UmeTrack model from a .torch checkpoint file for hand pose regression inference
find_dataset: find and load real and synthetic EMG-to-pose datasets from the UmeTrack torch_data directory with specified fields
